content.comment_body: I have a [product_name] and recently purchased a digital expansion module. Do I need to specify anywhere in the program that I've added the module to the base, or does the system automatically detect it? Also, for counting inputs, should I just add the numbers together, for example 8+2 to get input 10? I hope my question is clear. Thank you, [user_name]
You do not need to specify the hardware in the software. All possible I/O options are available for configuration (try checking them out). For details about counting, consult the manual.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is unsure how the programming software recognizes and manages digital expansion modules when added to their base hardware. There is uncertainty about how input channels are counted after expansion. Another forum participant explained that the software typically allows access to all possible I/Os without requiring manual hardware specification, implying automatic detection, though the process might not be obvious to new users.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that the programming software should automatically detect added expansion modules and seeks a straightforward way to identify the total available and usable inputs.
